L57@P1: 4.1 Description of first aid measures
L58@P1: First Aid: Eye
L59@P1: Immediately flush eyes with plenty of flowing water for 10 to 15 minutes holding eyelids apart. Consult an
L60@P1: ophthalmologist.
L61@P1: First Aid: Skin
L62@P1: Wash immediately with plenty of water and soap for at least 15 minutes. Remove contaminated clothing
L63@P1: and shoes. Wash contaminated clothes before reuse. Call a physician.
L64@P1: First Aid: Ingestion
L65@P1: Wash out mouth with water provided person is conscious. Call a physician.

L67@P1: Hints for Physician: Symptoms

L70@P1: First Aid: Inhalation

L52: # The Original Plant-Powered Drink.^{®}
L53: 
L54: 【25†Image】
L55: 
L56: ## V8^{®} Original Vegetable Juice
L57: 
L58: At V8, our mission for over 80 years has been simple: make it easy for everyone to get tasty veggies. Our original ‘red’ juices have two servings of vegetables in each full glass. We make 8 different varieties for all tastes, from our famous Original recipe to V8 Spicy Hot vegetable juice.
L59: 
L60: * * *
L61: 
L62: ## Key Ingredients
L63: ### Tomato Puree
L64: 
L65: Our tomatoes are mainly grown in California by family farmers, many of which have grown tomatoes for V8 for generations. The ripe tomatoes are harvested and transported directly to our nearby plants to be washed, peeled, and pureed. Tomato juice is a key ingredient in our V8 100% Vegetable Juices.
L66: ### 7 Vegetables
L67: 
L68: Carrots, celery, beets, parsley, lettuce, watercress and spinach juice are blended to create our unique flavor. These vegetables are grown mostly in the U.S. and then driven to our processing facility in Napoleon, Ohio where they are washed, pureed, and concentrated.
L69: 
L70: * * *
L71: 
L72: 【26†Image】
L73: ## Other Ingredients
L74: 
L75: • Salt: Table salt adds seasoning and flavor.
L76: 
L77: • Potassium chloride: Potassium chloride is used only in the Low Sodium varieties of V8 vegetable juice to provide salty flavor without adding sodium.
L78: 
L79: • Citric acid: We add citric acid to control the acidity of our products to ensure product safety. Our citric acid is derived from Non-GMO sources.
L80: • Natural Flavors: Our natural flavors are primarily derived directly from fruits and vegetables. No animal products are used in the natural flavoring for V8 juices.
L81: 
L82: • Ascorbic acid (Vitamin C): Ascorbic acid is another name for vitamin C. It occurs naturally in many foods and we add it to replace the naturally-occurring vitamin C in tomatoes that may be lost during preparing and cooking the juice.
L83: • Vitamin A (Beta Carotene): The Vitamin A in V8 Vegetable Juice products occurs both naturally, as well as through the addition of Beta Carotene. Your body converts beta carotene to Vitamin A.
